name: gpt-connector
description: Connect web planning to local Codex through a private GitHub mailbox, with an optional self-hosted MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Think on the web. Build in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Three prompts connect web planning and local Codex through your own private GitHub repo. Each received task automatically gets a separate branch with context, task and result records. Web authorization and real GitHub tools are required. No unattended execution or automatic business-code pushes. Optional self-hosted MCP bridge remains available.
defaultPrompt: Use GPT Connector to connect this project through my private GitHub repo.
Use GPT Connector to receive an approved task and create its mailbox branch.
